description: Deadlock match and player stats from the Deadlock API, game knowledge from the Deadlock Wiki
name: deadlock-mcp

tools.description: A hero's most common and best-winning ability upgrade orders.
tools.name: ability_order

tools.description:
Popular in-game builds of a hero, or one build by its id: name, author, the build id to
import in game, favorites, items, and matches and win rate with the build selected.
tools.name: builds

tools.description: Heroes (with their abilities), abilities and shop items by name or id.
tools.name: game_lookup

tools.description: The enemy heroes a hero wins most and least against.
tools.name: hero_counters

tools.description:
Which shop items win on a hero, optionally against given enemy heroes. The win rates are
raw and favour items bought by players already ahead; `item_timings` adjusts for that.
tools.name: hero_items

tools.description: Win rate, pick rate and matches per hero over all players' matches.
tools.name: hero_stats

tools.description: The teammates a hero wins most and least with.
tools.name: hero_synergies

tools.description: Whether the player runs the API's ingest tool, which sends their matches as they play.
tools.name: ingest_status

tools.description:
Which shop items win on a hero in each phase of a match (0-9, 9-20, 20-30, 30+ minutes),
by win rate adjusted for the buyer's net worth at purchase, next to the raw one.
tools.name: item_timings

tools.description:
A lane duo against an enemy duo (or any duo): soul lead with its spread and damage lead at
each stats snapshot, and the win rate. Upstream marks the data as subject to change.
tools.name: lane_matchups

tools.description: The top players of a region's ranked leaderboard, optionally for one hero.
tools.name: leaderboard

tools.description:
Who damaged a player and whom they damaged, with what, and who finished them: per hero, damage
both ways by ability, weapon and item, killing damage and crowd control received.
tools.name: match_damage

tools.description:
How close a player stood to each other player: seconds within 10 to 60 m of each hero while both
were alive, over a window of the match.
tools.name: match_distance

tools.description: The three lanes of a match: who laned against whom and the soul lead every 3 minutes up to 15:00.
tools.name: match_lanes

tools.description:
One player's match in depth: result and why, net worth over time, souls by source, unspent souls, deaths
with killers, positions and the nearest objective, the build selected, purchases, ability upgrades and
permanent buffs.
tools.name: match_player

tools.description:
A match's mode, length, winner, objectives destroyed and Midboss kills, and every player's hero, lane,
K/D/A, souls, damage and own result.
tools.name: match_summary

tools.description: Patch notes and news: the list, or one patch's notes as text.
tools.name: patches

tools.description:
The average player's course of a match: net worth, K/D/A, last hits, damage and souls by
source at each stats snapshot (every 3 minutes up to 15:00, then every 5).
tools.name: performance_curve

tools.description:
Where on the map a player dies and kills most: hotspots in `match_player`'s map coordinates, with the
objective nearby.
tools.name: player_deaths_map

tools.description: The opponents a player met most and lost to most, with Steam names.
tools.name: player_enemies

tools.description:
A player's stats per hero: matches, win rate, K/D/A per match, souls and damage per minute.
Only the matches the Deadlock API has the full data of, so fewer than `player_overview`.
tools.name: player_heroes

tools.description: Who a player plays with: matches together and the win rate, with Steam names.
tools.name: player_mates

tools.description: A player's rank, win rate over counted matches, most played heroes and recent matches.
tools.name: player_overview

tools.description: Find a player's account id by Steam name, `SteamID64` or profile link.
tools.name: player_search

tools.description:
Percentiles of per-match player stats (souls per minute, K/D/A, damage, accuracy...), to
place one match's numbers among all players' matches.
tools.name: stat_percentiles

tools.description: The text of a Deadlock Wiki page, or of one of its sections.
tools.name: wiki_page

tools.description: Search the Deadlock Wiki for game mechanics, heroes and items.
tools.name: wiki_search
